nodes.title: Campaign Generator - Summer Streaming Originals
widgets_values:
## Campaign Generator - Summer Streaming Originals (Dell GB10 AI Content Studio demo)

Cinematic promotional visuals for a premium streaming service. Blue/silver palette, energetic, premium entertainment feel, 18-34 urban audience.

**Branches**
- Poster (Flux.2 Klein, 832x1216, batch 3) -> `campaign/poster`
- Thumbnail (Flux.2 Klein, 1280x720, batch 3) -> `campaign/thumbnail`
- Social Square (Flux.2 Klein, 1024x1024, batch 1) -> `campaign/social`
- Vertical Teaser (LTX 2.3 text-to-video, 720x1280, 5s @ 25fps) -> `campaign/teaser`

**Models used (installed only)**
- diffusion_models: flux-2-klein-9b-fp8.safetensors
- text_encoders: qwen_3_4b.safetensors, gemma_3_12B_it_fp4_mixed.safetensors
- vae: flux2-vae.safetensors
- checkpoints: ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-1.1.safetensors (merged distilled: dev + distilled LoRA baked in)
- latent_upscale_models: ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.1.safetensors

**Removed from the official templates**
- Audio decode/output chain in the LTX branch (LTXVAudioVAEDecode + AUDIO into CreateVideo) - no vocoder model installed. Internal joint AV-latent plumbing was kept since it only needs the already installed LTX checkpoint.
- LLM prompt-enhancement side branch (LoraLoader with gemma-3-12b-it-abliterated_lora_rank64_bf16 + TextGenerateLTX2Prompt + switch) in the LTX branch, for a deterministic authored prompt. This LoRA is installed but unused since the branch was removed.
- Swapped flux-2-klein-4b/base-4b -> flux-2-klein-9b-fp8 (installed distilled 'klein' path, cfg=1, 4 steps).
